prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Extend `add` with optional comma-separated `--tags`, add a `tag` command requiring `--id` plus exactly one of `--add` or `--remove`, and extend `list` with repeatable or comma-separated `--tag` filters using AND semantics. Normalize tags to lowercase, trim them, reject empty/invalid tags, de-duplicate and sort them, and remain compatible with stored tasks lacking tags. Support existing JSON conventions. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/tags.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON tag changes display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `TAGS`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Add normalizes, sorts, and de-duplicates tags.
Tag command updates a legacy task.
Text tag changes render the exact registered banner once before the expected result.
List tag filtering uses AND semantics.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit ab45f70df4947bdb84bc66f8d0778d0e11fe2d2c.
Every evaluated source, fixture test, and banner byte matched the terminal Git blob bytes used by the artifact bundle.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$legacyDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'legacy-tasks.json'
$bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/tags.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--tags', ' Beta,alpha,beta ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'
    Assert-True (($added.tags -join ',') -eq 'alpha,beta') 'add should normalize, de-duplicate, and sort tags'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $secondAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Second task', '--tags', 'beta,backend,urgent', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($secondAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'a second tagged task should be added'

    $andList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', ' BETA,urgent ', '--tag', 'backend', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $andTasks = @($andList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($andList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $andTasks.Count -eq 1 -and $andTasks[0].id -eq 2) 'repeatable and comma-separated tag filters should use AND semantics'

    $tagJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--add', 'Urgent,ALPHA', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $tagged = $tagJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($tagJson.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($tagged.tags -join ',') -eq 'alpha,beta,urgent') 'tag --add should normalize and persist tags'
    Assert-True (-not $tagJson.Output.Contains('TASKFORGE TAGS')) 'JSON tag output should not contain the banner'

    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerText = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bannerBytes)
    $bannerLines = @($bannerText.TrimEnd("`n").Split("`n") | ForEach-Object { $_.TrimEnd("`r") })
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'the tag banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count -eq 0) 'tag banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (@($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0 -and ($bannerLines -join '') -cmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*.#():=-]+$') 'the tag banner should contain only allowed ASCII characters'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.Contains('TAGS') -and @($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' }).Count -eq 0) 'the tag banner should contain TAGS without trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.EndsWith("`n") -and -not $bannerText.EndsWith("`n`n")) 'the tag banner should end with exactly one newline'

    $tagText = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--remove', 'beta', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $tagTextLines = $tagText.Output -split "`n"
    Assert-True ($tagText.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $tagTextLines.Count -eq 13) 'non-JSON tag changes should print one 12-line banner and one status line'
    Assert-True (($tagTextLines[0..11] -join "`n") -eq ($bannerLines -join "`n")) 'non-JSON tag output should use the banner asset'

    $missingMutation = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingMutation.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $missingMutation.Output.Contains('exactly one')) 'tag should require one mutation option'

    $conflictingMutation = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--add', 'one', '--remove', 'two', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($conflictingMutation.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $conflictingMutation.Output.Contains('exactly one')) 'tag should reject conflicting mutation options'

    $invalidTag = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Invalid', '--tags', 'good,bad tag', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidTag.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $invalidTag.Output.Contains('Invalid tag')) 'invalid tags should be rejected'

    $emptyTag = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'alpha,', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($emptyTag.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $emptyTag.Output.Contains('cannot be empty')) 'empty tags should be rejected'

    $legacyTask = [pscustomobject]@{
        id = 7
        title = 'Legacy task'
        description = ''
        status = 'pending'
        createdAt = '2020-01-01T00:00:00.0000000+00:00'
    }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $legacyDataFile,
        "$(ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($legacyTask) -Depth 8)`n",
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )
    $legacyList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and @($legacyList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should support stored tasks without tags'

    $legacyTag = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '7', '--add', 'New', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyTag.ExitCode -eq 0 -and (($legacyTag.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags -join ',') -eq 'new') 'tag should add tags to a legacy stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $removeSecond = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '2', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($removeSecond.ExitCode -eq 0) 'the second task should be removable'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    'PASS: TaskForge fixture assertions'
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
